blockedIdentities.reason: The registry label describes a Saint-Gobain performance-plastics process-system business scope rather than one unambiguous standalone manufacturer identity. A separate profile would risk duplicating or fragmenting the Saint-Gobain corporate entity.

SAIP is a short acronym used by unrelated industrial entities. Although a polyurethane-equipment company was found, the bare registry record has no legal-name, geography or product-scope discriminator that proves this is the intended manufacturer.

SALMSON is a legacy pump brand associated with Wilo, and no current standalone manufacturer-owned HTTPS profile with sufficiently clear brand continuity and product scope was established for publication.
SAMI is a generic name and acronym shared by unrelated current businesses. The registry record contains no domain, legal-name, geography or product-scope discriminator.
Searches for SAMIL INDUSTRY produced unrelated manufacturers in different sectors, and the registry record has no reliable discriminator selecting one official entity.
SAMSUNG identifies a corporate group and numerous distinct operating companies and product businesses. The bare record does not identify one industrial manufacturer entity or scope.
SATEC is used by unrelated current manufacturers in power metering and materials-testing equipment. The bare registry record has no product-scope or domain discriminator.
Sauer-Danfoss is a former corporate name now represented by Danfoss Power Solutions. The registry record cannot be released as a current standalone manufacturer without creating a legacy duplicate.
SCHNELL is shared by unrelated current industrial manufacturers. The bare registry record contains no legal name, geography or product-scope discriminator selecting the intended company.
SCHRACK can refer to distinct current businesses including Schrack Technik and Schrack Seconet. The repository record does not provide a safe discriminator.
SCIENTIFIC INSTRUMENTS is a generic company description used by multiple unrelated manufacturers. No unique legal name, domain, geography or product scope is present in the registry record.
SDMO is now presented through the KOHLER-SDMO business, while the apparent current official domain did not complete an HTTPS response. A current standalone SDMO identity could not be verified safely.

profiles.shortDescription: SAGOLA manufactures spray-finishing and compressed-air equipment for automotive refinishing and industrial coating. Its official range includes spray guns, airbrushes, filters, pumps and complete painting systems.
fullDescription: SAGOLA's manufacturer-owned site documents equipment used to prepare, control and apply liquid coatings. The portfolio combines manual spray guns and airbrushes with air-treatment filters, fluid pumps and supporting systems for bodyshops, industrial finishing and other professional painting processes.

profiles.shortDescription: SAI develops radial-piston hydraulic motors and integrated drive components for mobile and industrial machinery. Its official range covers fixed, dual and variable-displacement motors, wheel and shaft-end drives, brakes and accessories.
fullDescription: SAI's manufacturer-owned product pages document radial-piston and crankshaft hydraulic motors across fixed, double and continuously variable displacement configurations. Complementary products include complete wheel-drive units, shaft-end drives, brakes, valves, gearboxes and electronic controls for agriculture, construction, mining, marine and industrial equipment.

profiles.shortDescription: Saia Burgess Controls develops modular control and automation products for buildings, infrastructure and industrial systems. Its portfolio includes automation stations, monitoring devices, energy meters, field devices, room automation and software.
fullDescription: Saia Burgess Controls' official catalog presents open- and closed-loop control products for building, infrastructure and industrial automation. The documented range combines programmable automation stations, control and monitoring hardware, electrical energy meters, field devices, energy-management functions, room-automation components and engineering software.

profiles.shortDescription: SALMATEC develops machinery and complete systems for producing pellets from feed, biomass and recyclable materials. Its range includes pellet mills, conditioners, thermal-treatment equipment, dies and rollers.
fullDescription: SALMATEC's manufacturer-owned site documents equipment for preparing, conditioning and compacting raw materials into pellets. The portfolio spans pellet mills and compact pelletizing units, conditioners, expanders and other thermal-treatment systems, together with dies, rollers and turnkey plant engineering for feed, biomass and recycling processes.

profiles.shortDescription: Salvadori designs and manufactures equipment for recycling tires, conveyor belts and other rubber waste. Its official range covers tire downsizing, bead removal, shearing, buffing, moulding and finished-product processing systems.
fullDescription: Salvadori's manufacturer-owned site documents end-to-end equipment for converting end-of-life tires and conveyor belts into reusable material and finished rubber products. The portfolio includes debeaders and shears for passenger, truck and mining tires, buffing and mulching machines, moulding presses and plants, mixers, painting systems, cutters and related processing equipment.

profiles.shortDescription: SAMES develops equipment for applying liquid paint, powder coatings, adhesives and sealants. Its range combines spray guns, pumps, controllers, mixing and dosing systems, powder feed equipment and automated application technology.
fullDescription: SAMES' official product ranges cover the preparation, delivery and application of coating and bonding materials. Documented solutions include manual and automatic liquid-paint equipment, powder-coating systems, pumps, guns, controllers, electrostatic applicators, and mixing, dosing and extrusion technology for industrial finishing and assembly processes.

profiles.shortDescription: SAMIC manufactures process equipment and engineered plant modules for industrial applications. Its official portfolio includes heat exchangers, pressure vessels, tanks, columns, reaction chambers, skids and piping assemblies.
fullDescription: SAMIC's manufacturer-owned product page documents fabricated process equipment and packaged systems for demanding industrial plants. The range covers shell-and-tube heat exchangers, pressure vessels, storage tanks, columns, reaction chambers, and assembled skids with filtration, lubrication, control and process piping.

profiles.shortDescription: SAMIFLEX is a CITSA brand for elastomeric flexible couplings used in industrial power transmission. The official range includes standard, spacer, taper-bush and multifunction coupling configurations.
fullDescription: CITSA's official company and product pages identify SAMIFLEX as its flexible-coupling system for connecting rotating shafts. The documented portfolio covers standard flexible couplings, spacer versions for pump and process arrangements, taper-bush mounting variants and multifunction assemblies designed around replaceable elastomeric elements.

profiles.shortDescription: Sang-A Pneumatic manufactures connection and flow-control components for pneumatic systems. Its official portfolio includes push-in and two-touch fittings, speed controllers, tubes, couplers, pipes and chemical-resistant fitting ranges.
fullDescription: Sang-A Pneumatic's manufacturer-owned product portal documents components for connecting, routing and regulating compressed-air and fluid circuits. The range includes one-touch and two-touch fittings, speed controllers, tubing, couplers, pipes, accessories and specialized chemical fittings for industrial equipment.

profiles.shortDescription: Sanitaire is a Xylem brand for biological wastewater-treatment and aeration systems. Its official scope includes fine-bubble diffusers, aeration equipment and supporting process components for municipal and industrial treatment plants.
fullDescription: Xylem's official Sanitaire brand page documents equipment for transferring oxygen into wastewater and supporting biological treatment processes. The portfolio centers on fine-bubble diffuser systems and associated aeration components, with configurations for new treatment plants, upgrades and process-efficiency projects.

profiles.shortDescription: SANYO DENKI develops cooling, power-backup and motion-control equipment. Its official product portal covers San Ace cooling fans, SANUPS power systems and SANMOTION servo and stepping systems.
fullDescription: SANYO DENKI's manufacturer-owned product portal organizes the company's industrial equipment into three principal product families. San Ace covers cooling fans and fan units; SANUPS covers uninterruptible power supplies, inverters, power conditioners and engine generators; SANMOTION covers servo motors and amplifiers, stepping motors and drivers, and motion-control equipment.

profiles.shortDescription: SATRON develops process-measurement instruments for pressure, level, consistency, turbidity and related variables. Its range includes optical and pressure transmitters, mounting and service valves, sampling valves and pneumatic actuators.
fullDescription: SATRON's official product directory documents instruments and accessories for monitoring process liquids, gases and slurries. The portfolio combines LUMINA optical transmitters, PREON pressure and level transmitters, PASVE mounting and service valves, SAVE sampling valves and PISTOR pneumatic cylinders for process industries.

profiles.shortDescription: SAWA Pumpentechnik manufactures stainless-steel pumps for hygienic, chemical and industrial fluid handling. Its official range includes centrifugal, hybrid, submersible, peripheral and gear pumps.
fullDescription: SAWA's manufacturer-owned pump directory documents centrifugal and positive-displacement equipment for food, beverage, pharmaceutical, chemical and general process duties. The portfolio covers self-priming and standard centrifugal pumps, hybrid and submersible designs, peripheral and gear pumps, plus versions for hygienic, sterile, magnetic-drive and hazardous-area applications.

profiles.shortDescription: SCAIME develops sensors and electronics for industrial weighing, force measurement and process control. Its portfolio includes load cells, weighing terminals, force and torque sensors, displacement and pressure sensors, and fibre-optic measurement systems.
fullDescription: SCAIME's manufacturer-owned product directory documents measurement components for scales, automated processes, machinery and structural monitoring. The range combines analog and digital load cells, mounting kits and weighing electronics with force, torque, displacement and pressure transducers, extensometers, measurement amplifiers and fibre-optic sensing equipment.

profiles.shortDescription: Scavini manufactures laboratory instruments for testing petroleum products, fuels, lubricants, bitumen and greases. Its range covers flash-point, cold-property, oxidation-stability, demulsivity, foaming and viscosity testing.
fullDescription: Scavini's manufacturer-owned site documents manual and automatic apparatus for petroleum and lubricant analysis against recognized test methods. The portfolio includes flash-point testers, cloud and pour point instruments, oxidation-stability units, demulsivity and foaming testers, viscosity baths, bitumen and grease instruments, and equipment for gasoline, aviation fuel, antifreeze and engine-coolant testing.

profiles.shortDescription: Schaltbau develops electromechanical switching and connection components for high-load applications. Its portfolio includes AC and DC contactors, connectors, snap-action switches, control devices and emergency disconnect switches.
fullDescription: Schaltbau's manufacturer-owned product directory documents components for safely switching, connecting and controlling electrical power and signals. The range combines high-voltage AC and DC contactors, industrial and railway connectors, snap-action switches, command devices and emergency disconnect products for rail, energy, e-mobility and industrial systems.

profiles.shortDescription: SCHERZINGER Pumpen develops precision gear pumps and pump systems for industrial fluid handling. Its official portfolio covers external and internal gear pumps, gerotor pumps and application-specific pumping solutions.
fullDescription: SCHERZINGER's manufacturer-owned product directory documents positive-displacement pump technology for metering, lubrication, transfer and circulation duties. The range includes external-gear, internal-gear and gerotor designs, with engineered variants for different media, pressures, temperatures and installation requirements.

profiles.shortDescription: Scheuch develops industrial air-pollution-control, extraction and conveying systems. Its portfolio spans dust collection, flue-gas cleaning, pneumatic conveying, fans, valves and related plant components.
fullDescription: Scheuch's official group and portfolio pages document engineered systems and components for controlling dust, process emissions, noise and odours. The group's businesses provide large-scale air-pollution-control plants, extraction and dedusting systems, mechanical and pneumatic conveying, filters, fans, rotary valves, dampers and lifecycle services for industrial facilities.

profiles.shortDescription: Schindler develops elevators, escalators and moving-walk systems for buildings and transport infrastructure. Its official portfolio also includes modernization, digital and lifecycle service solutions.
fullDescription: Schindler's official corporate and product pages document vertical and horizontal mobility systems for residential, commercial, public and transport environments. The portfolio covers passenger and freight elevators, escalators, moving walks, modernization packages, digital monitoring and maintenance services.

profiles.shortDescription: Schlemmer manufactures cable-management and protection products for vehicles, machinery and industrial installations. Its range includes plastic conduits, textile sleeving, cable-protection accessories and application-specific protective systems.
fullDescription: Schlemmer's manufacturer-owned site and catalog document components that protect cables, wiring harnesses and fluid lines against abrasion, impact, heat and environmental exposure. The portfolio combines corrugated plastic tubing, textile and braided sleeving, closures, fittings and accessories for automotive, railway, agricultural, construction and industrial equipment.

profiles.shortDescription: SCHMIDT-KUPPLUNG develops precision shaft couplings for motion and power transmission. Its portfolio includes offset, torsionally rigid, servo, bellows, compact and backlash-free coupling designs.
fullDescription: SCHMIDT-KUPPLUNG's manufacturer-owned site and product catalog document coupling solutions for transmitting torque between aligned, offset and moving shafts. The range includes Schmidt, Semiflex, Controlflex, Servoflex, Loewe GK and Omniflex product families for machinery, automation, positioning and drive applications.

profiles.shortDescription: Schneider-Kreuznach develops and manufactures precision lenses, optical filters and integrated optical systems. Its industrial portfolio supports machine vision, metrology, inspection and scientific imaging.
fullDescription: Schneider-Kreuznach's official site documents optical design, component manufacturing and system integration for industrial imaging. The portfolio includes C-mount, telecentric, SWIR, line-scan, large-format, liquid and ruggedized lenses, optical filters, adapters and assembled optical systems for machine vision and measurement applications.

profiles.shortDescription: Schönbuch Sensor develops proximity and optical sensors for industrial detection tasks. Its range includes inductive, capacitive and magnetic proximity switches, photoelectric sensors, contrast sensors, fork sensors and light-barrier systems.
fullDescription: Schönbuch Sensor's manufacturer-owned product directory documents sensing devices for detecting objects, position, contrast and luminescence in machinery and automation. The portfolio covers inductive, capacitive and magnetic proximity sensors, through-beam and reflective photoelectric devices, contrast and luminescence sensors, fork and frame sensors, and accessories.

profiles.shortDescription: SCHORCH develops low- and high-voltage electric motors for industrial and hazardous-area applications. Its portfolio includes rib-cooled, modular, flameproof and variable-speed motor families.
fullDescription: ATB Schorch's official product directory documents electric motors in cast-iron and fabricated-steel constructions for line and inverter operation. The range spans low-voltage IEC motors, medium- and high-voltage rib-cooled and modular designs, explosion-protected motors, and high-speed machines for industrial drives.

profiles.shortDescription: Schramm is an Epiroc brand for reverse-circulation drilling equipment. Its official range includes truck- and crawler-mounted drill rigs, reverse-circulation hammers and bits, auxiliary systems and aftermarket support.
fullDescription: The official Schramm site presents the current brand as Schramm Powered by Epiroc and documents equipment for mineral exploration, grade control, water wells and geothermal drilling. The portfolio covers 455 and 685 series drill rigs, AD-series reverse-circulation hammers and bits, LOADSAFE auxiliary equipment, parts, service and rig support.

profiles.shortDescription: SCHUNK develops gripping, automation, toolholding and workholding technology for industrial production. Its portfolio includes grippers, robot accessories, linear and rotary modules, toolholders, chucks, jaws and stationary clamping systems.
fullDescription: SCHUNK's manufacturer-owned site organizes its portfolio around gripping systems, automation technology, tool clamping and workpiece clamping. Documented products include pneumatic and electric grippers, robot accessories, linear and rotary axes, toolholders, lathe chucks and jaws, zero-point clamping, vises and modular workholding systems.

profiles.shortDescription: SCHURTER develops electronic components, input systems and engineered electronic solutions. Its portfolio covers circuit protection, connectors, switches, EMC products, capacitors, resistors and human-machine interfaces.
fullDescription: SCHURTER's official product directory documents components for protecting, connecting, switching and operating electronic equipment. The range includes fuses and circuit breakers, power-entry modules and connectors, switches and indicators, EMC filters, chokes, capacitors, resistors, supercapacitors, touch panels and customized input systems.

profiles.shortDescription: SCHWING Technologies develops high-temperature systems for thermal cleaning, process technology and heat treatment. Its range includes vacuum-pyrolysis, fluidized-bed, pyrolysis-oven and post-treatment systems for industrial tools and components.
fullDescription: SCHWING Technologies' manufacturer-owned pages document systems that remove polymers and organic residues from metal production tools and machine parts. The portfolio includes VACUCLEAN vacuum-pyrolysis systems, INNOVACLEAN fluidized-bed systems, compact and large pyrolysis furnaces, thermal afterburners, post-treatment equipment and fluidized-bed process and heat-treatment technology.
